#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from cryptography import x509
from cryptography.x509.oid import NameOID
from cryptography.hazmat.backends import default_backend

def check_certificate():
    cert_path = "/app/ssl/server.crt"

    # Check if certificate file exists
    if not os.path.exists(cert_path):
        print(f"Error: Certificate file not found at {cert_path}")
        sys.exit(1)

    try:
        # Load the certificate
        with open(cert_path, "rb") as cert_file:
            cert_data = cert_file.read()
            cert = x509.load_pem_x509_certificate(cert_data, default_backend())

        # Extract Common Name
        cn = cert.subject.get_attributes_for_oid(NameOID.COMMON_NAME)[0].value

        # Extract expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format
        expiration_date = cert.not_valid_after_utc.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

        # Print certificate details
        print(f"Common Name: {cn}")
        print(f"Expiration Date: {expiration_date}")

        # Verify certificate is currently valid
        now = datetime.utcnow()
        if now < cert.not_valid_before_utc:
            print("Error: Certificate is not yet valid")
            sys.exit(1)
        elif now > cert.not_valid_after_utc:
            print("Error: Certificate has expired")
            sys.exit(1)

        print("Certificate verification successful")

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error loading or verifying certificate: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    check_certificate()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import sys
import subprocess
import re
from datetime import datetime

def check_certificate():
    cert_path = "/app/ssl/server.crt"

    # Check if certificate file exists
    if not os.path.exists(cert_path):
        print(f"Error: Certificate file not found at {cert_path}")
        sys.exit(1)

    try:
        # Get certificate text using OpenSSL
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["openssl", "x509", "-in", cert_path, "-text", "-noout"],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=True
        )
        cert_text = result.stdout

        # Extract Common Name from subject
        subject_match = re.search(r"Subject:.*?CN\s*=\s*([^,\n]+)", cert_text)
        if not subject_match:
            print("Error: Could not extract Common Name from certificate")
            sys.exit(1)
        cn = subject_match.group(1).strip()

        # Get dates using OpenSSL
        dates_result = subprocess.run(
            ["openssl", "x509", "-in", cert_path, "-dates", "-noout"],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=True
        )
        dates_text = dates_result.stdout

        # Extract expiration date
        not_after_match = re.search(r"notAfter=(.+)", dates_text)
        if not not_after_match:
            print("Error: Could not extract expiration date from certificate")
            sys.exit(1)

        # Parse the date and convert to YYYY-MM-DD format
        date_str = not_after_match.group(1).strip()
        # OpenSSL format: "Sep  4 21:01:03 2027 GMT"
        expiration_dt = datetime.strptime(date_str.replace("  ", " "), "%b %d %H:%M:%S %Y %Z")
        expiration_date = expiration_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

        # Print certificate details
        print(f"Common Name: {cn}")
        print(f"Expiration Date: {expiration_date}")

        # Verify certificate is currently valid
        not_before_match = re.search(r"notBefore=(.+)", dates_text)
        if not not_before_match:
            print("Error: Could not extract start date from certificate")
            sys.exit(1)

        not_before_str = not_before_match.group(1).strip()
        not_before_dt = datetime.strptime(not_before_str.replace("  ", " "), "%b %d %H:%M:%S %Y %Z")
        now = datetime.utcnow()

        if now < not_before_dt:
            print("Error: Certificate is not yet valid")
            sys.exit(1)
        elif now > expiration_dt:
            print("Error: Certificate has expired")
            sys.exit(1)

        print("Certificate verification successful")

    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print(f"Error running OpenSSL command: {e.stderr}")
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error loading or verifying certificate: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    check_certificate()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import sys
import subprocess
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone

def check_certificate():
    cert_path = "/app/ssl/server.crt"

    # Check if certificate file exists
    if not os.path.exists(cert_path):
        print(f"Error: Certificate file not found at {cert_path}")
        sys.exit(1)

    try:
        # Get certificate text using OpenSSL
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["openssl", "x509", "-in", cert_path, "-text", "-noout"],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=True
        )
        cert_text = result.stdout

        # Extract Common Name from subject
        subject_match = re.search(r"Subject:.*?CN\s*=\s*([^,\n]+)", cert_text)
        if not subject_match:
            print("Error: Could not extract Common Name from certificate")
            sys.exit(1)
        cn = subject_match.group(1).strip()

        # Get dates using OpenSSL
        dates_result = subprocess.run(
            ["openssl", "x509", "-in", cert_path, "-dates", "-noout"],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=True
        )
        dates_text = dates_result.stdout

        # Extract expiration date
        not_after_match = re.search(r"notAfter=(.+)", dates_text)
        if not not_after_match:
            print("Error: Could not extract expiration date from certificate")
            sys.exit(1)

        # Parse the date and convert to YYYY-MM-DD format
        date_str = not_after_match.group(1).strip()
        # OpenSSL format: "Sep  4 21:01:03 2027 GMT"
        expiration_dt = datetime.strptime(date_str.replace("  ", " "), "%b %d %H:%M:%S %Y %Z")
        expiration_date = expiration_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

        # Print certificate details
        print(f"Common Name: {cn}")
        print(f"Expiration Date: {expiration_date}")

        # Verify certificate is currently valid
        not_before_match = re.search(r"notBefore=(.+)", dates_text)
        if not not_before_match:
            print("Error: Could not extract start date from certificate")
            sys.exit(1)

        not_before_str = not_before_match.group(1).strip()
        not_before_dt = datetime.strptime(not_before_str.replace("  ", " "), "%b %d %H:%M:%S %Y %Z")
        now = datetime.utcnow()

        if now < not_before_dt:
            print("Error: Certificate is not yet valid")
            sys.exit(1)
        elif now > expiration_dt:
            print("Error: Certificate has expired")
            sys.exit(1)

        print("Certificate verification successful")

    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print(f"Error running OpenSSL command: {e.stderr}")
        sys.exit(1)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error loading or verifying certificate: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    check_certificate()
